name: game-assets
description: 3D / gamedev work: textures, materials, Blender scripts, Unreal assets. Codex (GPT-6 Astra) generates textures and code; Claude keeps the asset contract (names, resolutions, formats, folders).
claude_keeps: asset contract (names, sizes, formats, target folders, naming of maps)

tasks.slice: one card: list of assets with resolution/format/folder, engine version, acceptance (file exists, dimensions, imports cleanly)
texture sets (albedo/normal/roughness/…) as PNG straight into scope; verify dimensions
Blender `bpy` scripts / exports (glTF/FBX) or Unreal code (C++/Blueprint-Python/.ini) — disjoint scope from textures
import instructions for the engine, asset list, licence note
check every file exists, dimensions are powers of two, scripts run headless
wire assets into the project, merge in id order

notes: Blender/Unreal missing on this machine → executors still deliver scripts/code plus run instructions (doctor `tools` shows what is installed).
Textures: powers of two, seamless when tiled, one PNG per map; never left in the tool's scratch folder.
